altered_content.description: Always true for us (AI voice + AI visuals) — set 'altered content = yes' at upload (D-025).

caption.description: One-sentence cross-post caption + link to the long video (D-038).

pinned_comment.description: The pinned comment. Phase 1.3: leads with the answer to the video's closing_question + an invite to reply ('Mine was copy-paste. What's yours?') — a single topical conversation starter, not engagement-begging (STYLE_GUIDE §9). May also carry utility text (the copy-pasteable master prompt / template link) — never in the 3-sentence description.

community_post.description: YouTube Community/Posts announcement (D-042): a 'just published' line + a 1-2 sentence teaser + the long-video link. Generated for EVERY video; the owner posts it manually (the Data API can't create Community posts). <LONG_URL> is filled at upload.

bridge.description: The deliberate Short → Long → pin → template → cross-post chain, so Shorts feed the under-fed long-form discovery. We upload MANUALLY (D-055) and never touch YouTube's native link/end-screen UI, so this is a PACKAGE + a one-line manual_checklist the owner follows in the Shorts/long editor — the system can't click the native link itself.

related_long_id.description: content id of the long video this video drives discovery to (null when there is none).

long_url.description: Placeholder <LONG_URL> until upload; the owner fills the real long-video URL (used in the caption, pin, and end screen).

short_caption.description: The Short's cross-post caption ending in the long-video link (mirrors short.caption; consumed by the distributor).

pinned_comment.description: The pinned comment that answers the closing question + links the long/template (mirrors publish.pinned_comment).

template_link.description: Copy-paste template/resource link surfaced in the description + pin (null when none).

end_screen_target.description: Which video the end screen points to (the related long).

manual_checklist.description: One-line manual steps for the owner (link the related video in the Shorts editor; add the end screen; pin the comment; paste the template link).

medium.description: Medium cross-post (D-038): keyword-rich title + cover reuse.
